name: Fool
ability: The first time you die, you don't.
interaction: None. On the first death that would happen, the Fool stays alive and gets the No ability reminder; if executed, the Storyteller announces the execution but that they do not die.
drunk_or_poisoned: A drunk or poisoned Fool dies normally and the ability is not used up.

rulings.text: If another effect already prevents the death (Monk, Innkeeper, Tea Lady, Soldier...), the Fool's ability is not used.
An executed Fool survives; announce the execution without explaining why. A second execution kills them.
The wiki page writes '1st'; roles.json writes 'first'. Same rule.

test_scenarios.name: survives demon
test_scenarios.setup: 5 players: 1 Fool, 2 Imp, 3 Poisoner, 4 Chef, 5 Empath.
test_scenarios.expected: Seat 1 lives and gets No ability; nobody dies at dawn.

test_scenarios.name: execution
test_scenarios.expected: Executed but stays alive; No ability placed; no further execution that day.

test_scenarios.name: protected first
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2 Monk protects seat 1; Imp kills seat 1.
test_scenarios.expected: Seat 1 lives and keeps the Fool ability.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned fool
test_scenarios.setup: 5 players: 1 Fool, 2 Imp, 3 Poisoner, 4 Chef, 5 Empath.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2 Poisoner poisons seat 1; Imp kills seat 1.
